pages.title: Lost and Found
pages.text: It keeps dropped items within its range from vanishing.$(br2)By default a basket reaches seven chunks in every direction — a square fifteen chunks across — and a basket cannot be placed inside another's area. Where two areas meet at the edges, the nearer basket takes the item.

Right-click the basket to open it; it holds a large chest's worth of slots, and breaking the basket spills everything on the ground.$(br2)Around a basket, dropped items age faster, so a lost stack is caught sooner instead of waiting out its full lifetime; items that never expire are left alone.$(br2)Wear $(l:special_tools/strange_glasses)Strange Glasses$(/l), or hold a basket in either hand, to see its range.
